desc: The Tikka T3x Lite Veil Wideland Rifle lineup is your perfect companion for hunting and shooting in southern forests and open plains. These models come with cerakote coating on the barrel, enhancing weather durability. For reducing recoil, the manufacturer has incorporated muzzle brake in these rifles. The special features of Tikka T3x Lite Veil Wideland Rifles include a fluted bolt with an oversized knob, a new modular synthetic stock with interchangeable pistol grips, a new asymmetrical grip pattern and shape for solid grip in all conditions, a new recoil pad (for reducing the impact of recoil on the shooter), stock noise reduction (thanks to the foam insert within the rear stock’s interior), a redesigned widened angular ejection port (making it easier to feed one cartridge at a time), improved Picatinny rail attachment with extra screws (for better use of larger scopes), metallic bolt shroud, and extra-strong steel recoil lug.
